notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Adrian and Camila came to every day of VBS. Mailed the family a thank-you card with the kids' craft pages and an invitation to the next family night.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Gaby called to ask whether Adrian's VBS shirt turned up. It was at the welcome desk, and she will pick it up this week. She asked about the Sunday kids rooms, so I sent her the times.

notes.author: ted
notes.text: Called Jose to invite the family to a Sunday. He was friendly but said weekends are full with work right now. Left the door open and will invite them to the next kids event.
notes.testPurpose: A follow-up with a family that has not come on a Sunday.
